Lincare Holdings Inc. is a major American home healthcare and durable medical equipment (DME) company headquartered in Clearwater, Florida. It specializes in providing respiratory therapy products, medical equipment, and chronic care services directly to patients in their homes. It operates as a subsidiary of the multinational chemical and industrial gases company [Linde plc](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linde_plc).

- **Oxygen therapy:** Liquid oxygen, concentrators, and portable systems

- **Sleep apnea treatment:** CPAP and BiPAP devices, masks, and accessories

- **Respiratory equipment:** Nebulizers, ventilators, and related supplies

- **Specialized care:** Enteral (nutrition) therapy and home infusion services [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lincare_Holdings)

### Company Profile

- **Scale:** Serves over 1.8 million patients across 49 states through more than 700 local operating locations.

- **Parent Organization:** Acquired by the Linde Group (now Linde plc) in 2012.

- **Staff:** Employs thousands of professionals, including licensed respiratory clinicians and field support staff. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lincare_Holdings)
